msg: Hello! The game is simple, you will see coloured gnomes in pairs, you can ignore their hats and how they look. The colour is whats important. One will always lead to a bright forest, the other to a dark forest. It seems in between task breaks one forest will always give more mushrooms than the other. The pairs are Orange & Brown, Green & Pink, Red & Yellow, Blue & Purple. Orange, green, red and blue lead to bright forest. Brown, pink, yellow, purple lead to the dark forest.Your goal is to gather the most mushrooms, so try to figure out quickly which forest in each stage is giving the most mushrooms, the most you can get is 9, and the average is around 6 if you pick the right forest. In some cases it can give 0! Make sure you ALWAYS give a response, if you time out you will get ZERO mushrooms. You don't get long to pick a gnome then press space in the forest. Good luck!
